comparison.objective: Load five glass slides into narrow staining-rack slots; candidate adjusts and locks a gripper.
comparison.physical_skill: Fragile thin-part grasping and millimetre slot insertion versus driver/wrench countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Five released upright slides, one per slot, versus a locked target angle retained across cycles.
comparison.reason: Both require precision, but the tested mechanisms and outcomes differ materially.
